# Copilot Instructions

This file provides guidance to GitHub Copilot when working with code in this repository.

**IMPORTANT**: Read and follow all guidelines in [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) for complete project conventions, development commands, blog post structure, markdown style, APA citations, and git commit conventions.

## Copilot-Specific Rules

- **Always use git CLI commands** via terminal, NEVER use GitKraken or other MCP git services
